mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals an active monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the average forward return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.6% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain or raise rates, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.6%, or the average forward return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.8 million units signals strong housing demand and rising consumer confidence, which correlates with elevated equity risk appetite and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1800.0, or the average forward return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 98.8 index points signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 98.8, or the average forward return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and residential investment (RSAFS) signals broad-based demand strength that supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between the joint signal and 60d forward returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the average forward return in joint-triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising CPIAUCSL combined with a stable FEDFUNDS rate signals that inflation is outpacing monetary policy response, increasing expectations of future rate hikes and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 201.3 and FEDFUNDS <= 4.94, or the average forward return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market recovery that boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 135106.0 and UNRATE < 4.6, or the average forward return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) combined with rising residential construction (HOUST) indicates a robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between the joint signal and 60d forward returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the average forward return in joint-triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
